title: Eight page-private click targets in the mocks are still mouse-only
goal: After the shared keyboard pass, a browser audit finds eight things across three design-study pages that react to a click through their own page script but cannot be reached with Tab or pressed with Enter: the mode names on the design-system modes page, the easing swatches on the motion page, and one icon and one chip on the image page. Give each of them a keyboard path so the study has no mouse-only control left.
notes: Found by shared/audit-keyboard.mjs on 2026-09-01 after core.js took over [data-target], .sec-h and .menuitem. Remaining (informational line of the audit): ds-modes span.cn x2 + span.cn.active, lang-motion div.ease.es/.ed/.esp, image i.ic.sm + div.ch. These bind their own click in the page inline script, so the fix is per page: role, tabindex=0, keydown Enter/Space -> click (see AGENTS.md Keyboard reach). Small, mechanical.
acceptance: node shared/audit-keyboard.mjs (from docs/design/mocks) reports 0 private pointer targets
Each of the eight takes focus with Tab and activates with Enter or Space
Each announces a role to a screen reader
